test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 2) Mid-Range Full Test - 03
subject: general
question:
Which of the following letter-clusters should replace # and % so that the pattern and relationship followed between the letter-cluster pair on the left of :: is the same as that on the right side of ::?

# : ADG :: MIL : %
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2d16e50abe1a866069dc7ff61c99f97f83c1c43a73bc7da4d0c011f370fc1dfe.png] 

The logic followed here is :- (5) is subtracted from the position value according to English alphabetic series.

​So,

 
• # = FLI , % = HDG ⇒ FLI : ADG :: MIL : HDG

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/de936eb5b3a22bc301b27f863260d02e5eb0782757ddbac5429f4ac9a7144259.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3330faf1ff4240c4428f196b493105ab17c3d6e99016b10dfa7c8ecf9b41ac8f.png] 

⇒Here, no similar pattern can be seen.

 
• # = FIL , % = HGD ⇒ FIL : ADG :: MIL : HGD

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/615a11e9d3a2f7d7eeff07fff7aab4fd23a073430f35ca4457f7763a4a8d97d5.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2e10bc3924905f760b5eb52ca953738d81c4e4d694f2fbf89dfe0fdeea058f7c.png] 

⇒Here, no similar pattern can be seen.

 
• # = FIL , % = DGH ⇒ FIL : ADG :: MIL : DGH

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1ad427cd94058744eb73c0f9ff1725bb41a2cf5698b889de00516c95b89761b7.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/65bac8199953b26382f33cc28211c3fbd72c98330ba2b1a3acbafedef9a0255b.png] 

⇒Here, no similar pattern can be seen.

 
• # = FIL , % = HDG ⇒ FIL : ADG :: MIL : HDG​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a6bc665b1c58ba1747dcd3020630b7d92f38bfc138a674bcb0b378fd1a5a792a.png] 

**⇒Here, similar pattern can be seen.**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option - (4)".
